the development of a new method for the study of the effects of the FGF2 in vivo.

the development of a new class of biological agents that can be used in the treatment of lung diseases, including pulmonary fibrosis, a devastating disease that is associated with high morbidity and mortality.
the development of new therapeutic strategies to prevent and/or treat pulmonary fibrosis.
